field_text_formatted.value: Any link can set a fragment, though, so a crafted one could point the preview, and the editor's token, at somebody else's server. Druxt Node Preview only fetches from its own origin, its Drupal site, or origins you list, and keeps the preview route out of shared caches and search engines.
